entities.name: Query protein 275 aa
observations: Sequence length is 275 aa; estimated molecular weight is 27.81 kDa.
Theoretical pI is 9.09 and estimated charge at pH 7 is +4.10, indicating a basic protein.
Pfam domains: NAD_binding_3 (PF03447) at residues 47–125 and Asp_DH_C (PF01958) at residues 135–266.
The sequence is an exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q5LPG8, annotated as L-aspartate dehydrogenase.

entities.name: Q5LPG8
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Ruegeria pomeroyi annotated as L-aspartate dehydrogenase.
Catalyzes NAD- or NADP-dependent dehydrogenation of L-aspartate to iminoaspartate; associated EC 1.4.1.21.
Annotated with NAD/NADP binding and participation in NAD+ biosynthetic process.

entities.name: L-aspartate dehydrogenation
observations: Reference reaction: L-aspartate + NAD(P)+ + H2O yields oxaloacetate + NH4+ + NAD(P)H + H+; Rhea mappings include RHEA:11784 and RHEA:11788.
The enzyme annotation describes formation of iminoaspartate as the immediate dehydrogenation product, with hydrolytic deamination represented in the mapped reaction.

entities.name: NAD+ biosynthetic process
observations: Reviewed reference annotation associates L-aspartate dehydrogenase activity with GO:0009435, NAD+ biosynthetic process.
